Halvorsen Valley General Hospital - Radiology Patient name: OKONKWO-HALE CHIDI EMEKA Hospital no: HV-6021-553 DOB: 02-Apr-2017 Age: 48 Y Examination: X-RAY BOTH HANDS (PA and oblique) Date: 26 June 2065 Requested by: Dr T. Veselinovic Report by: Dr Anjali Deshpande-Krüger, Consultant Radiologist
Clinical details: Pain and stiffness both hands, since 3 months. ?arthritis. Hx of left forearm laceration Nov 2063.
Findings: Joint space narrowing with osteophytes involving the distal interphalangeal joints of the index, middle and ring fingers bilaterally, and the first carpometacarpal joints. Subchondral sclerosis present. No erosions. No chondrocalcinosis. Bone mineral density appears preserved. The carpal alignment is maintained. Soft tissues unremarkable. No foreign body seen in relation to the previous forearm laceration (not imaged).
Impression: Features of primary osteoarthritis of the hands, in keeping with the clinical history. No inflammatory erosive change.
